headline.text: L1 S4 had *two* metal contamination events — Theegarten finger broke during operation, then metal spatula pulled into slitter hours later. Both required line stops and equipment inspection.

summary: Three active holds or FM flags across two plants. L1 S4 Theegarten finger broke off mid-run (piece missing, level-2 clean performed); hours later a metal spatula was pulled into the same line's slitter. L3 ML4 had a broken piece found by the line and depositor magnet bolts discovered missing. All under investigation.

holds.title: Dark caramel held for color deviation
holds.summary: S4 caramel ran very dark after extended downtime — color does not meet customer spec, QA placed batch on hold.
holds.status: On hold — Ebrima confirmed hold at 03:38 MT, pending disposition decision.

food_safety.title: S4 Theegarten finger broke off during operation
food_safety.summary: Wrapping machine finger broke at 22:56 MT, piece missing — QA requested level-2 clean of Theegarten before restart.
food_safety.status: Resolved — level-2 clean completed, ATP passed at 08:23 MT, line restarted.

food_safety.title: S4 metal spatula pulled into slitter
food_safety.summary: EE used metal spatula to remove watery caramel from belt; spatula pulled into slitter at 06:13 MT, scratched multiple components — maintenance replaced all slitter and scraper blades as precaution.
food_safety.status: Resolved — all affected blades replaced by 08:23 MT, equipment inspected and cleared, line restarted.

food_safety.title: ML4 broken piece found by production line
food_safety.summary: Spencer found broken fragment near ML4 at 16:42 MT — maintenance confirmed issue fixed, but part origin and product exposure window unclear.
food_safety.status: Resolved — Spencer confirmed fix at 17:01 MT same evening, no further details posted.

food_safety.title: ML4 depositor 4 magnet trap bolts missing
food_safety.summary: Magnet and heating plate on depositor 4 not functioning — inspection found bolts missing on south side at 15:48 MT.
food_safety.status: Resolved — maintenance repaired same shift, magnet ATP passed at 16:41 MT.

quality.title: S4 flow wrap failures — pieces unwrapped or improperly sealed
quality.summary: Significant number of pieces coming out without wrap or poorly sealed at 12:57 MT — operator adjusted, then CILT performed and Theegarten cleaned.
quality.status: Resolved — wrap quality improved after cleaning at 14:49 MT, confirmed good at 14:56 MT.

quality.title: S4 watery batch identified — incomplete mixing
quality.summary: Watery batch found during 3rd shift production at 05:41 MT — residual sugar discovered in mixing tank, indicating batch not fully mixed.
quality.status: Open — batch identified and flagged, no posted disposition or corrective action yet.

sanitation.title: S4 tunnel 1 belt dirty, rails misaligned after reassembly
sanitation.summary: Operators inspecting tunnel 1 at shift start found belt very dirty, rails in wrong locations, some installed upside down and unlatched — suggests cleaning/reassembly gap on prior shift.
sanitation.status: Resolved — operators corrected rail alignment and cleaned belt same morning before restart.

opportunities.text: Consider adding metal utensil ban and non-metal tool staging to S4 caramel removal SOP — today's spatula-in-slitter event echoes risk when EEs improvise during long downtimes.

Review S4 tunnel 1 reassembly checklist and shift handoff — rails found inverted/unlatched this morning suggest gap in post-maintenance verification or unclear visual standards for correct orientation.
Add depositor magnet bolt torque check to ML4 startup inspection — today's missing bolts on depositor 4 were only caught when heating failed, not during pre-shift walkthrough.
